column1: # Every \input target of main_R2.tex, supplement.tex and sections/*.tex, with the
# script that writes it. Guard 5 in scripts/build_guards.py fails the build when a
# document inputs a file this manifest does not declare.
# Written 2026-08-27, after the third artefact in this project turned out to have
# no producer: Table S.10 (hand-authored from a pre-correction vintage), two .tex
# files edited after generation, and tab_master_results.tex, whose only writer was
# a script MANIFEST.md had marked SUPERSEDED. Three instances make a class, and a
# class gets a guard rather than another note.
# kind: generated = a script writes it; authored = prose, written by hand on purpose.
